maria: Quick wireframe pass for Hosted / Dedicated / Private pages. Goal: one clear hero, 3 bullets, micro-benchmark line, primary webinar CTA, inbound routing note.
ashley: Draft hero: 'One API. Any deployment. Production SLAs.' Two CTAs: Register Webinar / Request Demo.
jon: Micro-benchmarks (one-liners): Hosted — ~50 ms median token latency; Dedicated — reserved pools, predictable throughput; Private — SOC 2, VPC, KMS.
kevin: Inbound routing pseudo: enterprise->sdr@, private_interest->solutions@, webinar_signups->marketing@. Add "primary_use_case" field to form.
maria: Keep bullets active: 'Unified API', 'Predictable unit economics', 'Enterprise controls & auditability'. Link to benchmark PDFs.
marketing-bot: Reminder: finalize CTAs by Mon 16:00 PT.
ashley: I'll upload variants to the Website Copy doc and tag for review.
